wins: Mapped network perimeter with targeted nmap scans, confirming ports 22 and 80 open for the primary host (evidence: ep001_step04).
Captured initial SSH banner and basic service fingerprints, enabling tailored enumeration (evidence: ep001_step05).
fails: Failed to escalate privileges after initial foothold; privilege checks returned limited access (evidence: ep001_step09).
Persistence attempts using scheduled task creation were blocked by group policies, leaving no stable backdoor (evidence: ep001_step12).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was executed effectively, but post-exploitation could not complete due to privilege and persistence resistance, yielding the 0% success rate.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-exploitation scripts consistently fail to escalate privileges; limited access prevents lateral movement.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap ssh-* scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80 returns default server header
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy gobuster directory scan with wordlists/web-content

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial shell lacks elevated privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Run linPEAS and check SUID/guid binaries for escalation paths
